pages.title: Three routes afte...
pages.text:
After the Claw stage, you can work on three branches:\
**Pattern / Clock:** mechanical processing.\
**Colony / Swarm:** bees and their production chains.\
**Hum / Spark:** living power and workshops.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Complete and seat **any two** of these three Strands to unlock Braid Cord. A team can divide the work. You will still need all nine Strands for the final reweave.

pages.title: Make Braid Cord
pages.text:
1\. Check that two of Clock, Swarm and Spark are seated at your Post. Merely holding their tokens is not enough.\
2\. Hold a **Strand Filament**.\
3\. Right-click the Post to receive **Braid Cord**.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Do not put tokens in a crafting grid. They record progress. If the Post refuses, read its message and check which Strands are seated.\
Next: follow Bind and the Sigil quests.
